 FIRST ALERT WEATHER: Heavy floods hit Las Vegas valley on Friday 
 10/31/26 
 Rain and thunderstorm chances return to the Las Vegas Valley Friday, with cooler temperatures and additional showers expected through the weekend. By Ted Pretty Published : Oct. 30, 2026 at 6:10 AM PDT | Updated : 4 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google First Alert Weather Forecast
 Saturday:
 A lull between systems with mostly dry conditions to start the day with isolated shower chances. Las Vegas is expecting a high of 70°. Trick-or-treaters may encounter showers as rain chances ramp up across the region in the afternoon and evening. This could dampen some late night Halloween party plans.
 Sunday:
 As the weather system moves inland late Saturday night into Sunday, it brings a better chance of widespread rain. The forecast high in Las Vegas is 68°. Snow levels stay high above 9,000 to 9,500 feet.
